scriptdef.name: Konwersja tabeli ProdOkresy - kasowanie wyzwalacza ProdOkresy_Delete_AktualizujMRPwTWR

ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'ProdOkresy_Delete_AktualizujMRPwTWR' AND xtype = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.ProdOkresy_Delete_AktualizujMRPwTWR

create TRIGGER CDN.ProdOkresy_Delete_AktualizujMRPwTWR ON CDN.ProdOkresy FOR DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON
update TWR set twr_mrpid = isnull(POK_id,0) FROM CDN.TwrKarty twr left join CDN.ProdOkresy on pok_obityp = 16 and POK_ObiNumer = Twr_GIDNumer where twr_MRPid in (select POK_Id from deleted)
SET NOCOUNT OFF
